local_facts.claim: NOAA engineering weather data for Tampa records 5,093 annual hours meeting its humid-area criterion of wet-bulb temperature above 67°F.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Long humid periods make marginal refrigerator door seals, condensation control, and dryer exhaust performance show up quickly during an appliance inspection.
local_facts.title: Tampa’s humid hours expose weak seals and airflow

local_facts.claim: The City of Tampa reported average finished-water hardness of 211 mg/L, or 12.3 grains per gallon, in its 2025 water quality report.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Mineral scale can affect dishwasher spray paths, filters, valve screens, and water-heating components. A technician checks the water side of the appliance before blaming the machine alone.
local_facts.title: Hard water is part of a Tampa dishwasher diagnosis

local_facts.claim: Tampa’s 2022 housing data counted 77,745 renter-occupied homes, 49.5% of occupied units, and 70,201 apartment units, 40.58% of all units.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Appliance work often requires coordination with a property manager or association and access through compact utility closets, elevators, gates, or building water-shutoff procedures.
local_facts.title: Tampa appliance repairs often run through multifamily access

pricing.table_head: Tampa appliance repair, job by job

anchors.label: Tax on a repair that includes any part
anchors.detail: Florida taxes the entire repair charge, labor included, whenever the shop supplies a part that becomes part of the machine, even if parts are not itemized. Labor only work is exempt only when the invoice documents that no parts were used.
anchors.source_name: Florida Department of Revenue guide GT-800010

anchors.label: Hillsborough County surtax on top
anchors.detail: The county's discretionary sales surtax for 2026 brings the combined rate on a taxable repair invoice in Tampa to 7.5 percent.
anchors.source_name: Florida DR-15DSS discretionary sales surtax rates for 2026

anchors.label: State license for appliance repair
anchors.detail: The county tax collector lists small appliance repair among tasks that do not require a contractor license, and issues no handyman receipt at all. Business tax receipts run to September 30 and are delinquent October 1.
anchors.source_name: Hillsborough County Tax Collector business tax license categories

anchors.label: City permit when a hookup actually changes
anchors.detail: Tampa charges $120 for a general residential plumbing, electrical or mechanical permit and $162 for natural or LP gas piping. Every permit carries a state building surcharge of 2.5 percent of permit value, with a $4 floor.
anchors.source_name: City of Tampa trade permit fee schedule
